text:
ops-bot: INCIDENT: authz-token-service returning elevated 503s in apac-west. Impact: token issuance failures for a subset of hosted API requests. Dashboard: https://redwood.incidents/1812501234

sam: Seeing ~3% 503s from ls-prod at 08:02 UTC, customers reporting auth failures when creating new sessions.

eng-lee: I'm rolling back the last token-service deploy (image: token-svc:build-57). Will update when rollback starts.

ops-bot: Rollback initiated by @eng-lee at 08:05 UTC. Automated fallback enabled: cached token path lifted for short-lived requests.

marie: Cache fallback brought error rate down to ~0.4% within 2 minutes. Continuing to monitor.

sre-olivia: Confirmed: dedicated customer routes unaffected. Issue constrained to hosted token issuance path in apac-west cluster.

nic: Filing support tickets for customers with >1% error: CUST-342, CUST-415. Drafting customer message.

eng-lee: Preliminary root cause: dependency regression in auth-lib v2.4.1 pulled into latest image — NPE during token mint path. Investigating why CI didn't catch it.

sam: Any impact on long-lived tokens or refresh flows? Need to surface to product.

eng-lee: No risk to existing tokens; refresh and validation paths OK. Only issuance endpoint hit the exception.

ops-bot: Current status: rollback completed at 08:12 UTC. Error rates back to baseline. Mitigation: rollback + cache fallback. Postmortem owners: @marie (lead), @eng-lee, @sre-olivia. Postmortem draft: https://redwood.internal/pm/1812501234-draft

marie: :thumbsup: I'll take timeline + deploy gating actions. Will include suggested CI checks for dependency pinning.

support-bot: Customer broadcast sent to affected accounts at 08:25 UTC. Template ID: SB-2026-77.

sam: Thanks everyone — closing this thread after PM posted. If anything unexpected crops up, reopen.
